chapter.title: The Wild
subtitle: Past the last lamp post the rules change.
Not by much. Your chest is still yours, and so is your grave.

hover: Grey means you already had yours.
Sideways, at dusk, on the shingle.
Wisp's people grow them in planters.
Taken off an iceologer, on a peak.
It goes where you are going anyway.
The corridors run further than they used to.
Five of these make the crown.

quests.title: String a Bow and Fletch 64 Arrows
quests.subtitle: Nothing in the valley needs shooting.
description: Craft a &aBow&r and 64 &aArrows&r before the first trip out. Reach counts for more than armour past the lamps.
A &aShield&r off the same bench is a fair second thought.

quests.title: Open a Chest Somebody Already Opened
quests.subtitle: Lootr gives every player their own roll.
description: Open any dungeon chest with a &bLootr&r face. The contents are yours alone, so nobody races anybody to it.
It goes grey once emptied. &6Places&r lists where they sit.

quests.title: Know What Happens If You Go Down
quests.subtitle: A grave, and everything still in it.
description: Read this before you go far. If you fall out there, a grave stands where you fell holding every item and level.
Walk back and open it. Nothing scatters and nothing despawns.

quests.title: Bring Back Two Crab Claws
quests.subtitle: They walk the shingle sideways at dusk.
description: Walk any sand or gravel shore until you find crabs, then take 2 &aCrab Claws&r home.
Friends & Foes put nine new creatures in the world. This is the mildest of them.

quests.title: Hang a Birch Beehive by the Orchard
quests.subtitle: It takes four bees where vanilla takes three.
description: Craft a &aBirch Beehive&r from six birch planks and three honeycomb, then set it where bees already work.
Take 3 &aHoney Bottles&r off it. &6Cooking & Brewing&r has work for them.

quests.title: Take a Totem of Freezing off an Iceologer
quests.subtitle: They stand on snow lines and throw ice.
description: Climb to a snowy peak and find an iceologer. It drops a block of ice on your head from range, so &cclose the gap fast&r.
Every one of them carries a &aTotem of Freezing&r.

quests.title: Cut Six Toadstools in the Reed Village
quests.subtitle: Wisp's people grow them in planters.
description: Wisp: "Take small ones. Big ones are somebody's roof."
Cut 6 &aToadstools&r and 4 &aRed Toadstools&r downstream at the reed village you first walked into in &6Act II&r.
Both replant themselves. Take from the edge of a patch.

quests.title: Walk a Nether Fortress End to End
quests.subtitle: YUNG rebuilt them: bridges, halls, a vault.
description: Step through a portal and find a fortress. The corridors run further than the old ones and the chests sit deeper in.
&cBlazes hold the stairwells.&r Bring the bow.

quests.title: Cut a Machete and Take 4 Hoglin Loins
quests.subtitle: Nether's Delight is a butcher's chapter.
description: Craft an &aIron Machete&r from two iron and a stick, then hunt hoglins in the crimson forest for 4 &aHoglin Loin&r.
The machete clears vines and nether roots in one swing as well.

quests.title: Bring Down One Wildfire
quests.subtitle: It keeps four blazes as a shield.
description: Find a wildfire deep in the fortress. It hides behind four blazes, so &cbreak the shield first&r.
It drops crown fragments. Five make a &aWildfire Crown&r that keeps blazes off.

quests.title: Follow an Eye of Ender to the Stronghold
quests.subtitle: Libraries, a prison, a well in the dark.
description: Throw an &aEye of Ender&r and walk after it. YUNG's strongholds are a proper ruin: libraries, a prison, a flooded well.
The portal room is still down there if you ever want it.

quests.title: Bring Back Sixteen Sculk Stone
quests.subtitle: Deeper and Darker rebuilt the deep dark.
description: Tobin: "It is not deepslate. I checked twice. It rings wrong."
Go back to the echo cave from &6Act V&r, mine 16 &aCobbled Sculk Stone&r and smelt it into &aSculk Stone&r.
&cThe warden hears every step.&r Crouch, and light nothing you do not need.

rewards.title: Sixteen, Rung Wrong
rewards.description: Next: the echo cave was only the doorstep. The Otherside opens off the ancient city's sculk frame with an Echo Shard.
